messages:
Alex: heads up — customer-reported edge: a streaming request got GC'd midflight, router trimmed the suffix, but a toolcall still executed and returned. billing looks... weird. can anyone check how ledger saw those tokens?
Taylor: ugh. do we have logs? session id / request id?
Alex: pasted snippet below (redacted):
```
router: evict session=svc-42 seq=120 reason=kv_gc
stream: truncate session=svc-42 truncated_tokens=48
toolcall: id=tc-9f4 completed=true duration_ms=34
billing: record provisional=false tokens=72
```
Priya: If billing recorded provisional=false but stream truncated, that sounds like we charged for tokens that never made it to the client or double-charged on a retry. any sign of retry?
Alex: client did reconnect and resumed; there were two toolcall entries for same logical tool and slightly different session ids. looks like router handoff + gc race.
Li: theory: router GC preemptively trims KV/prefix, causing the live stream to cut, then client reconnects to fallback which replays the toolcall. ledger sees both completions and confirms tokens immediately, so we end up double-confirming.
Jordan: confirm we currently mark tokens as "confirmed" on toolcall completion event (toolcall_done) not on client ack? if so that's the root.
Priya: right. we treat toolcall completion as durable proof. but in streaming cases the client may never receive suffix tokens if GC trimmed before flush.
Taylor: proposed fixes: 1) mark tokens provisional until end-of-stream client ack (or session commit). 2) attach session_commit_id to toolcall events so replayed toolcalls with same commit id dedupe.
Li: both are good. downside: provisional state requires background reconcile job + changes to DB schema (provisional_count, commit_pointer). heavier but safer.
Jordan: telemetry ask: add metric provisional_to_confirmed_delta and event sample for any session where provisional>confirmed_by > 0 after reconcile. must be low-cardinality.
Priya: console UX: add a small badge on per-request detail: "provisional tokens" and a reconciliation timeline. ops needs to see when we reconciled and why.
Alex: quick repro steps if anyone wants to reproduce locally:
1) start router with small kv_ttl=100ms
2) stream long prompt (seq ~150) with a toolcall triggered at seq 120
3) force GC on router midstream
4) let client reconnect to fallback and replay toolcall
Expected: one confirmed billing event. Current: two confirms.
Taylor: do we need backwards-compatible alter? maybe feature flag "prov-billing-v2" and canary in staging/dedicated first.
Li: yes — rollout plan: flag off by default. enable for 10% hosted, 100% dedicated (customers asked for reliability) then ramp.
Jordan: ops-bot — start canary job when PR lands?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment queued for branch alex/provisional-billing. target clusters: staging, canary-hosted-1. Will post results to #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:
Priya: who owns the console bits? I can do the UI for badge + timeline; need API changes from eng-platform to surface provisional counts per-request.
Alex: i'll take the router + event change (mark toolcall tokens provisional and include session_commit_id). Li will own ledger reconcile job. Priya will do console. Taylor can do telemetry and dashboards. Jordan you'll watch SLOs on canary.
Taylor: perf note: keeping tokens provisional increases DB writes on commit. let's sample heavy traffic first and monitor p95 write latency.
Li: implementation note: prefer an append-only provisional ledger table with TTL index to simplify GC. reconcile job moves counts into confirmed table and emits an event.
Priya: UX note: add small tooltip explaining "provisional = may be reversed if stream truncated or replayed".
Alex: ok plan approved. timeline: quick proto by EOD for router change, ledger reconcile PR by EOW, console/telemetry next week.
Jordan: also add alert if provisional_to_confirmed_delta > 5% traffic for 10m. ops wants early warnings.
Taylor: added grafana panel draft -> link https://grafana.internal/r/abc123 (will add to billing dashboard).
Alex: thanks all. tagging followups: Priya (console), Li (ledger), Taylor (telemetry), Jordan (oncall). i'll open a short RFC/PR with the design notes.
Priya: ack, will coordinate UI stories.
Li: will sketch reconcile algorithm + data model tonight.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary completed on staging — no regressions reported.
Alex: sweet. I'll post RFC link in this thread when ready.
